headline: Nscale, the London-based AI data center company preparing a New York share sale, has hired Meta veteran Justin Osofsky as its chief operating officer.
score_reason: Kept at 5: a confirmed senior hire at a company heading for an IPO, but a hire alone changes little for the wider market.
importance_line: It shows Nscale building a senior team from Meta veterans ahead of its planned share sale, which matters to its staff, customers and potential investors, but a hire does not tell us how the IPO or the business will perform.
summary: Bloomberg reports, and Nscale confirmed in a press release, that Justin Osofsky, who spent 18 years at Meta and was most recently its chief partnerships officer, will run Nscale's global operations and report to chief executive Josh Payne. Nscale filed in September for an IPO (its first share sale to the public) in New York and, according to Bloomberg News, is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion.
notes: Original outlet Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-02/nscale-hires-meta-s-justin-osofsky-to-be-coo-ahead-of-ipo) blocked (HTTP 403); wrote from the same Bloomberg wire text on Yahoo Finance, so source and url are Yahoo Finance's. Nscale's PR Newswire release (2 Oct 2026) also read and confirms the appointment.
